name: Spark Archive
summary: Open, extract and make archives: zip, tar (gz, bz2, xz, zst), 7z, rar and iso. Extract and Compress in Dolphin's right-click menu.
summary_fr: Ouvrir, extraire et créer des archives : zip, tar (gz, bz2, xz, zst), 7z, rar et iso. Extraire et Compresser dans le menu clic droit de Dolphin.

optional.compression.zstd: tar.zst with Python 3.14+ (otherwise the zstd command or libarchive)
optional.7z: password-protected 7z, and zip AES if libarchive can't decrypt it
optional.dolphin: the right-click menu and Show in folder

needs.system: Linux; Plasma 6 for the Dolphin menu
